'''Kehel Sinan''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[General/Legends|general]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:HGUDY" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Kehel Sinan was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:HGUDY" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Kehel Sinan was added to the game with the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Rebel Theme Park|Rebel Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:HGUDY" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 6 Notes for May 22 2007|Chapter 6]]" update, on [[May 22]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Notes – Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67250&month=052007|text=Publish Notes &ndash; Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild}}</ref>
